# iFoam Insulation

> > iFoam Insulation provides comprehensive spray foam and eco-friendly insulation solutions for residential and commercial properties, specializing in energy efficiency, air sealing, and crawl space encapsulation.

iFoam is a leading insulation contractor offering multiple insulation types including spray foam, blown-in cellulose, fiberglass, and batt insulation. The company serves both residential and commercial markets with professional installation, removal services, and franchise opportunities.

## Key Topics

- Spray Foam Insulation
- Energy Efficiency
- R-value
- Air Sealing
- Blown-in Cellulose Insulation
- Blown-in Fiberglass Insulation
- BATT Insulation
- Crawl Space Encapsulation
- Attic Insulation
- Residential Insulation
- Commercial Insulation
- Home Comfort
- ICAA Certified
- Free Consultation
- Insulation Removal

## Core Services

- [Spray Foam Insulation Services](https://www.ifoam.com/services/spray-foam-insulation): Expert spray foam insulation services highlighting energy efficiency and professional installation
- [Services Overview](https://www.ifoam.com/services): Main services page listing iFoam's residential and commercial insulation offerings
- [Residential Insulation](https://www.ifoam.com/services/residential-insulation): Premium residential spray foam and multiple insulation type services
- [Commercial Insulation](https://www.ifoam.com/services/commercial-insulation): Commercial insulation solutions with spray foam and cellulose options
- [Attic Insulation](https://www.ifoam.com/services/attic-insulation): Attic insulation services for energy savings and year-round home comfort
- [Air Sealing](https://www.ifoam.com/services/air-sealing): Professional air sealing services using spray foam and weatherization techniques

## Insulation Types & Solutions

- [Blown-In Cellulose Insulation](https://www.ifoam.com/services/blown-in-cellulose-insulation): Eco-friendly blown-in cellulose insulation services for residential and commercial
- [Blown-In Fiberglass Insulation](https://www.ifoam.com/services/blown-in-fiberglass-insulation): Blown-in fiberglass insulation services for fast, effective thermal performance
- [Blown-In Netting Insulation](https://www.ifoam.com/services/blown-in-netting-insulation): Blown-in netting insulation services for superior thermal protection and efficiency
- [BATT Insulation](https://www.ifoam.com/services/batt-insulation): High-performance batt insulation solutions with fiberglass, mineral wool, and cotton options
- [Crawl Space Encapsulation](https://www.ifoam.com/services/crawl-space-encapsulation): Expert crawl space encapsulation services using spray foam and vapor barriers for moisture control

## Specialized Services

- [Insulation Removal](https://www.ifoam.com/services/insulation-removal): Professional insulation removal services for residential and commercial properties
- [Concrete Lifting](https://www.ifoam.com/services/concrete-lifting): Polyurethane foam concrete lifting and polyjacking services for driveway repair
- [Barn Insulation](https://www.ifoam.com/services/barn-insulation): Agricultural barn insulation using spray foam and traditional insulation methods
